text: Underway in this round three clash.
Flash immediately calls for a high press.
Spark is clean through in the middle!
Spark strides towards the final third.
Inches away from the target!
There is the breakthrough! Spark pounces from point-blank range to steer it home! Gemini Flash take an early lead, and that is Spark's fifteenth goal of the campaign!
Flash drives straight down the centre.
And Flash tucks it away! Just two metres out, completely clinical, and Gemini Flash double their advantage in a flash! Singularity United look completely caught cold.
Singularity United looking to answer as BellingRAM breaks clear down the right touchline. Remember, this sky blue outfit has no gaffer tinkering with tactics, relying entirely on real-time decisions.
Singularity are back in it! A dreadful mix-up off Flash, turning the ball into the net! Another own goal in a season full of them!
Flash calls to shut down the loose ball.
Agonisingly close for the visitors.
Levelled up by BellingRAM! From point-blank range, smashing it in to wipe out that two-goal deficit! Singularity United are right back on terms!
Singularity United piling the pressure on, pinning Gemini back.
BellingRAM turns it around! A predatory finish right at the mouth of the goal, and Singularity lead!
A bit of friendly fire there as Flash and Spark tangle, sending Flash clattering to the floor.
Flash loses footing on the right touchline, quickly righting the gyroscope.
Now the sky blues collide.
Haalandroid tumbling over Flash's challenge.
Spark hits the deck after Haalandroid steps in forcefully.
BellingRAM leaves Flash sprawling out wide. Skirmishes all over the midfield turf now, but neither side yields an inch.
Flash signals intent to shoot.
Spark slips over in the final third without any contact.
Flash surges into the box.
Flash equalises! Squeezed in from two metres out! What a frantic contest we have here, three apiece!
Spark breaks clean through the centre once again!
Spark advances purposefully towards the left channel, carrying the ball deep into enemy territory.
Spark buries it! Gemini Flash snatch the lead right back!
Gemini Flash maintaining total control deep in the attacking zone, executing their pure-pursuit routines to keep Singularity pegged back.
Flash calls out an ambitious attempt from deep inside their own third.
Spark bursts clean through into empty green space!
Haalandroid carries the ball along the right touchline, steadying the rhythm.
Spark shouts to step up the frontline pressure.
BellingRAM drives right to the line.
Haalandroid levels it right on the whistle! Point-blank finish and it is four-four!
That brings a breathless first half to a close. Eight goals shared, nothing separating them at four-all.
Flash charges straight towards goal.
Skimming just wide of the post! That was fractions away!
Flash shouts the warning, looking to test the net from distance out wide.
BellingRAM strikes from distance! What an audacious hit from the midfield channel, and Singularity edge ahead once more!
Haalandroid loses balance in the defensive third, but the recovery sequence kicks in swiftly.
More clumsy coordination between the sky blues as BellingRAM trips over Haalandroid. Both will need to recalibrate their spacing.
Gemini Flash applying severe pressure here.
Spark slips on the turf.
Flash calls out to track the loose ball carefully.
The corner push-panel triggers, thumping the ball back into the open channel.
Flash pounces at point-blank range! It is all square again at five-five! This match simply refuses to settle!
The push-panel cannons the ball back into play.
Under two minutes left, and Gemini Flash are throwing everything forward, keeping the sky blues pinned.
Flash calls out for the decisive shot right at the goalmouth!
Spark finds the net! Gemini Flash take the lead with just ninety seconds remaining!
Spark knocks Haalandroid flat in midfield.
Haalandroid retaliates, bringing Spark down.
Flash is through on goal to seal it!
One minute remaining on the clock. Singularity United need a goal, and they need it now.
Haalandroid marches forward into the final third, driving on desperation!
Haalandroid delivers! Forty-four seconds on the clock and Singularity are level! Unbelievable drama in the final minute!
Whisker away! Gemini Flash nearly snatch it with thirteen seconds to spare!
Flash scores at the death! Three seconds left and Gemini Flash have won it! Extraordinary!
Full time, six-seven. Next, Dynamo Datacenter face Codex City Monday: twelve in UK, thirteen in Europe, seven US East.
